mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Heat flows from the colder end toward the heated end.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: With the same heating and setup, a wooden strip releases the pins just as quickly as an aluminium strip.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Only pin I falls; pins II, III, and IV stay attached.

intelligence.enrichment: In conduction through a solid, one particle receives heat and transfers heat to the next particle in contact, while the particles themselves do not move away from their positions. Heating one end of the solid raises the temperature near that end first, then heat passes along the solid to more distant parts, melting wax and releasing pins in sequence. The learner correctly applies this rule: In conduction through a solid, one particle receives heat and transfers heat to the next particle in contact, while the particles themselves do not move away from their positions. The flame makes every part of the metal strip hot at once, so all four pins should fall together.
